Name: SVE - Lance Come Sooner Pls
Author: squiddonaut
Description:
This is a simple mod I made in about an hour. It makes it so you can meet Lance after reaching level 120 of the Mines, as opposed to reaching the Ginger Island Caldera for the first time. However, he will still go to Ginger Island on certain days, so he will be inaccessible then until you unlock Ginger Island.

To get the new introductory cutscene for Lance, visit the Adventurer's Guild after reaching level 120 of the Mines.

This mod makes minor dialogue edits to both his introductory and 0-heart Farm cutscene to make them appropriate to the circumstances. Because of these dialogue edits, however, this is an English-only mod.

Requires Stardew Valley Expanded (and all of its dependencies) and Content Patcher.

All credit for Lance and Stardew Valley Expanded goes to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/46021252]FlashShifter[/url]. This mod was made with FlashShifter's permission.
